meta.ogTitle: HuddlePace — 15-Minute Huddles That Actually Take 15 Minutes
meta.ogDescription: Eliminate meeting drift. Vector accompanies your Slack Huddles with real-time visual progress bars, blocker alerts, and clean wrap-up cues.

heroLead: Vector introduces real-time visual progress bars, midpoint blocker prompts, and wrap-up warnings to your Slack Huddles. Zero audio recording, zero drift, 100% focus.
simAlert: Midpoint Flight Check: Over 60% of estimated time has elapsed. If you have critical technical blockers, bring them to the table now before touchdown.
vectorSub: The timekeeper for your Slack workspace.
vectorDesc: Vector runs right inside your Huddle threads. He tracks elapsed time, prompts the team for blockers at midpoint, and signals the wrap-up when time is up—so nobody has to play meeting cop.
vectorTrait2: Live progress updates without spamming the channel
pillarsHeading: Engineered to Keep Your Team on Flight Path
pillarsSubheading: Three non-negotiable architectural principles that protect deep engineering focus.
pillar1Desc: Launch instant sessions with /pace 15m or structure percentage-based topics. Visual progress updates automatically inside the Huddle chat without spamming the main channel.
pillar2Desc: Your privacy is sacred. HuddlePace never records audio, captures transcripts, or stores private conversation content. It purely manages time, session state, and cadence.
pillar3Desc: Native OAuth v2 ("Add to Slack") multi-tenant setup. No servers or ngrok tunnels required for external teams, with HMAC-SHA256 request verification across every event.
footerDesc: Slack-native meeting cadence and speaker companion. Engineered for deep-work engineering teams who respect meeting timeboxes.
footerPill: 🛡️ Multi-Tenant OAuth · ⚡ 100% Cadence Control · 🦅 Vector Pacer v1.0

privacyMeta.title: Privacy Policy — HuddlePace
privacyMeta.description: How HuddlePace collects, uses, and protects data when you install the Slack app. Zero audio recording, zero transcripts, plain-language data practices.
privacyMeta.ogDescription: How HuddlePace collects, uses, and protects data when you install the Slack app.

privacyLead: HuddlePace never records audio, never stores transcripts, and only keeps what it needs to run your meeting timers.
privacyS1Body: HuddlePace ("HuddlePace", "we", "us") is a Slack app operated by tBeltty. This policy explains what data we collect when you install and use HuddlePace inside your Slack workspace, why we collect it, and how you can control it. Installing HuddlePace means you accept the practices described here.
privacyS2Intro: Slack workspace data. When your workspace admin installs HuddlePace via "Add to Slack" (OAuth v2), Slack shares the following with us, scoped to the permissions you approve:
privacyS2Item1: Workspace/team ID and name, and the bot access token needed to post and update timer messages.
privacyS2Item2: Channel IDs where a session is scheduled or a Huddle is detected, so Vector can post and update the tracking card.
privacyS2Item3: User IDs of session organizers and assigned speakers, used only to verify who may start, transition, or conclude a session and to send them private DM reminders.
privacyS2Item4: Agenda structure you enter yourself: module names, percentage allocations, and total meeting duration.
privacyS2Support: Support data. If you use the "Help" widget on this site or contact support@huddlepace.com, we (via our support platform, the tBelt dashboard) collect the name, email address, and message content you choose to submit, solely to respond to your request.
privacyS2Technical: Technical data. This website sets a single functional cookie (huddlepace_lang) to remember your language preference. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.
privacyS3Body: HuddlePace does not request Huddle audio, does not record calls, does not generate transcripts, and does not read the content of your channel messages beyond the slash commands and interactive actions (buttons, modals) you or your teammates trigger directly. This is a core design constraint of the product, not just a policy promise.
privacyS4Item1: Operate core functionality: starting, tracking, and concluding timeboxed sessions, and posting progress updates to the right channel or thread.
privacyS4Item2: Enforce role-gated controls, so only assigned speakers or organizers can control a session.
privacyS4Item3: Generate the pacing reports and 30-day session history available to your workspace via /pace report and the App Home tab.
privacyS4Item4: Respond to support requests submitted through the Help widget or by email.
privacyS4NoAi: We do not send any workspace data to third-party LLMs or paid AI APIs. HuddlePace has zero external AI dependency.
privacyS5Intro: We do not sell your data. We share the minimum necessary with:
privacyS5Item1: Slack Technologies, LLC — as the platform that transmits and receives our app's API calls. Slack's own privacy practices apply to your use of Slack itself.
privacyS5Item2: tBelt Dashboard — our support ticketing platform (operated by tBeltty). If you submit a support request, the name, email, and message you provide are processed there so a human can reply to you.
privacyS6Body: Workspace and session data is stored in a self-hosted database (SQLite via Prisma) that HuddlePace operates directly — it is not shared with third-party data warehouses or analytics platforms. OAuth access tokens are stored encrypted at rest. Session and agenda records are retained to power your 30-day pacing reports; you can request earlier deletion at any time (see Section 8). Uninstalling HuddlePace revokes our access token immediately; we delete the associated workspace record within 30 days of uninstallation.
privacyS7Body: All traffic between Slack and HuddlePace is verified using HMAC-SHA256 request signing. Each workspace's credentials are isolated from every other workspace (multi-tenant isolation) — no workspace can access another's data, tokens, or session history.
privacyS8Body: You can uninstall HuddlePace from your Slack workspace at any time from Slack's App Management settings, which immediately revokes our access. To request a copy or deletion of your workspace's data ahead of the standard retention window, email support@huddlepace.com or use the Help widget on this site.
privacyS9Body: HuddlePace is a business productivity tool intended for use by Slack workspace members in a professional context. It is not directed at, and we do not knowingly collect data from, children under 16.
privacyS10Body: We may update this policy as HuddlePace evolves. Material changes will be reflected by updating the "Last updated" date above. Continued use of HuddlePace after a change constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
privacyS11Body: Questions about this policy or your data? Reach us at support@huddlepace.com or via the Help widget in the corner of this page.
